lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Hey, Producer.
What's up?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: People are really digging

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: this new single that just dropped.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: It's been at the top of the charts for two weeks straight.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Everyone's raving about it like it's the greatest thing

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: and going gaga for it.
It's a great tune.
Did you expect anything less? You're the best!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: You gave it a listen too?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I appreciate that!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Thank you wonder.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: No, no...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: When did I start getting used to speaking like this?
It seems you are quite satisfied with this plan to change the way you speak.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: No, no way!
This song's quite different from your usual style.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I knew you'd notice that!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: This song is about separation.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: In a world where the Ark and surface are divided,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: this song speaks about the passionate and heartbreaking romance

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: of lovers forced apart.
No wonder I teared up while listening to it.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Really? You did?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: It was a tough subject for me to write about.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'm glad the lyrics had an impact.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Be sure to listen to it often for me!
Of course! I even bought 500 of your CDs.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: That many?!
They were giving out collectible cards with each album you buy.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Collectible cards?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Were they picture cards?
Yeah, I'm gonna collect them all.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Are you sure about that?
I bought 500 copies, so I think it's possible.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: You really didn't have to do all this...
I want to do my part in ensuring you stay at the top of the charts.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Thank you, but 500 copies is a bit overkill, don't you think?
I'm gonna keep buying more until I collect all the collectible cards.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Do you think my other fans

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: are buying as many as you are?
I wouldn't doubt it. We all love you.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: All right, for the next album,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'm going to prepare something special to repay all my loyal fans.
That would be amazing!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'll put my heart and soul into it,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: so stay tuned!
